## BigDecimal

9-digit operands, precision 28. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter.

| Operation | decimo | libmpdec | vs libmpdec | CPython `decimal` | vs CPython |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| add | 45.3 ns | 36.2 ns | 1.25× slower | 49.6 ns | **1.10× faster** |
| subtract | 46.9 ns | 34.8 ns | 1.35× slower | 53.2 ns | **1.13× faster** |
| multiply | 41.7 ns | 28.2 ns | 1.48× slower | 44.8 ns | **1.07× faster** |
| divide | 150.5 ns | 49.8 ns | 3.02× slower | 68.0 ns | 2.21× slower |
| round | 39.3 ns | 36.5 ns | 1.08× slower | 72.7 ns | **1.85× faster** |
| parse | 90.3 ns | 44.4 ns | 2.04× slower | 79.3 ns | 1.14× slower |

In place, where neither side allocates a result:

| | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x += y` | 6.5 ns | 8.5 ns | **1.32× faster** |
| `x -= y` | 44.2 ns | 8.4 ns | 5.25× slower |
| `x *= y` | 55.2 ns | 22.0 ns | 2.51× slower |

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen, at three
precisions. `2.3456789`, and `**1.5` for power.

| Precision | operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 2.66 µs | 845.9 ns | 3.15× slower |
| 28 | exp | 4.31 µs | 4.27 µs | parity |
| 28 | ln | 4.54 µs | 12.31 µs | **2.71× faster** |
| 28 | power | 11.14 µs | 33.83 µs | **3.04× faster** |
| 100 | sqrt | 4.42 µs | 4.05 µs | 1.09× slower |
| 100 | exp | 10.08 µs | 14.34 µs | **1.42× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 67.36 µs | 37.92 µs | 1.78× slower |
| 100 | power | 87.10 µs | 77.57 µs | 1.12× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 52.48 µs | 213.64 µs | **4.07× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 381.51 µs | 4.44 ms | **11.65× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 2.81 ms | 5.53 ms | **1.97× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.29 ms | 11.17 ms | **3.39× faster** |

## BigDecimal across operand sizes

Operand digits, not precision. Add and multiply are **exact** on both
sides (decimo `precision=0`, libmpdec `mpd_maxcontext`); divide targets
operand width + 8 digits on both. decimo's time, then how it compares.

Verified this run: both libraries produce the same 2000-digit
product from the 1000-digit operands.

| Digits | add | | multiply | | divide | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | 37.3 ns | 1.26× slower | 37.9 ns | 1.35× slower | 144.5 ns | 3.07× slower |
| 100 | 42.9 ns | **1.28× faster** | 109.8 ns | **1.32× faster** | 1.33 µs | 3.87× slower |
| 1,000 | 110.0 ns | parity | 2.68 µs | **3.28× faster** | 28.71 µs | 2.02× slower |
| 10,000 | 790.0 ns | 1.24× slower | 130.81 µs | **2.75× faster** | 553.62 µs | **2.25× faster** |
| 100,000 | 8.45 µs | 1.37× slower | 2.58 ms | **1.09× faster** | 13.61 ms | parity |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.

| Digits | decimo add | CPython add | | decimo multiply | CPython multiply | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 37.4 ns | 24.3 ns | 1.54× slower | 82.8 ns | 100.5 ns | **1.21× faster** |
| 1,000 | 53.8 ns | 90.5 ns | **1.68× faster** | 1.11 µs | 5.37 µs | **4.84× faster** |
| 10,000 | 276.0 ns | 784.2 ns | **2.84× faster** | 53.46 µs | 258.08 µs | **4.83× faster** |
| 100,000 | 2.38 µs | 7.97 µs | **3.35× faster** | 1.16 ms | 8.58 ms | **7.38× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| 100 | 8.33 µs | 44.75 µs | 43.29 µs | 32.04 µs |
